exposure: intimate partner violence during the COVID-19 pandemic
home visiting professionals' practice during the pandemic
outcome: perceptions of IPV risk and complexity
desire to continue using online platforms post-pandemic
cohort: The cohort comprised 21 Australian women professionals who conduct home visiting with families experiencing intimate partner violence.
finding: Practitioners reported an increase in the risk and complexity of intimate partner violence during the COVID-19 pandemic, leading to rapid adaptation of practices, including a desire to continue using online platforms post-pandemic for increased client safety, flexibility, and accessibility.
